selection: Fixed formulas/windows/weights. Validation: higher net return, Sharpe gain >= 0.1, MDD no more than 2 percentage points worse at both cost levels; positive net excess return in each half-year at normal costs. Select the qualifying candidate with highest normal-cost Sharpe. Only that candidate enters holdout, with the same return/Sharpe/MDD gates at both costs. No replacement after a holdout failure. Otherwise all weights remain zero.
execution: Signals from completed bar, fills at following bar open with adverse slippage; all taker fees. Same bot portfolio/risk functions for baseline and candidates; cash/quantity ledger; no margin. Daily UTC rebalance and close-based stops. Activity guard excluded from factor research and must be tested separately before live rollout.
limitations: Fixed present-day 11-coin universe has survivorship/selection bias; Binance historical fills cannot validate Roostoo liquidity, minimum lots, latency or execution reliability. Historical holdout is not a prospective experiment.
